en.title: 5 Airbus A321neo routes with lie-flat business class seats, from JetBlue Mint to an all-business-class boutique
en.summary: The A321neo and its long-range derivatives have brought lie-flat business class from widebodies to narrowbodies; JetBlue flies Mint from New York to Los Angeles and London, La Compagnie operates 76 flat beds between Newark and Paris, and TAP and SAS use the A321LR to open transatlantic routes too thin for a widebody.
body: Lie-flat business class was a widebody privilege until June 15, 2014, when JetBlue introduced Mint on an Airbus A321 flying New York-JFK to Los Angeles. American, Delta and United were charging premium fares for recliner seats on the same route, and JetBlue's flat beds and stronger onboard product undercut them; the competitive response reshaped premium transcontinental flying at all four carriers. A decade on, the A321neo and its long-range derivatives carry lie-flat seats on US transcontinental routes and across the Atlantic, with the A321LR able to reach London from New York, so a narrowbody now competes directly with widebodies on routes that were closed to it a generation ago.

JetBlue's current A321neo Mint cabin holds 16 seats: 14 Mint Suites and two Mint Studios in a 1-1 layout, giving every passenger direct aisle access. JetBlue says each Mint seat is a private suite with a door that converts to a fully flat bed with Tuft & Needle adaptive foam cushions and a T&N pillow and comforter. The two Studios at the front have what JetBlue describes as the largest television on a US airline at 22 inches, plus a mirrored vanity, extra storage and a guest seat and table; The Points Guy measured the Studio bed at just over 82 inches in flat mode, calling it the largest flat bed on any US airline. The same seat flies across the Atlantic: the A321LR carries 24 Mint seats, 22 Suites and two Studios in the same 1-1 layout, fitted with the Thompson Aero VantageSOLO. JetBlue flies Heathrow twice daily from JFK in the winter 2026-27 season, alongside JFK-Paris and Boston-Heathrow and Boston-Paris, with Amsterdam, Dublin and Edinburgh served from New York and Boston and Madrid and Milan from Boston, more A321LR transatlantic routes than any other airline.

The other three operators use the type differently. La Compagnie flies an Airbus A321neo with 76 lie-flat business class seats and no other cabin, on its core Newark-Paris Orly route, with seats in a 2-2 layout that leaves some passengers without direct aisle access. The aircraft replaced Boeing 757s in 2019, upgrading angled-flat seats to true flat beds, and the airline also serves Milan from Newark and adds Nice seasonally. TAP Air Portugal deploys its A321LRs mainly between Lisbon and North America, with the Thompson Vantage lie-flat seat in a staggered layout; Lisbon's position further west than any other major European hub shortens the Atlantic crossing, and the type also serves Africa and Brazil. Scandinavian Airlines operates three A321LRs with the Thompson Vantage between Scandinavia and North America; the airline entered Chapter 11 in 2024, moved from Star Alliance to SkyTeam in September 2024 and now counts Air France-KLM as a shareholder. The economics are the point: JetBlue's A321LR carries 138 seats, 24 of them Mint, while a widebody Atlantic crossing needs demand for 250 or more seats, so the type opens city pairs that could not support a widebody.

facts.claim: Lie-flat business class belonged to widebodies until June 15, 2014, when JetBlue Airways launched Mint on a single route between John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) and Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), using an Airbus A321.

JetBlue's A321neo carries 16 Mint seats, comprising 14 Mint Suites and two Mint Studios, arranged 1-1, so every passenger has direct aisle access, and every Mint seat converts to a fully lie-flat bed with Tuft & Needle adaptive foam cushions and a T&N-designed pillow and comforter.

The Mint Studios carry a 22-inch television, plus a mirrored vanity, extra storage, and a guest seat and table; The Points Guy measured the Studio bed at just over 82 inches in lie-flat mode, calling it the largest lie-flat bed on any US airline.

The Airbus A321LR carries 24 Mint seats, comprising 22 Mint Suites and two Mint Studios, in the same 1-1 layout, fitted with the Thompson Aero VantageSOLO; JetBlue serves Heathrow twice daily from JFK for the winter 2026-27 season, alongside JFK to Paris and Boston to both Heathrow and Paris.

JetBlue operates more A321LR transatlantic routes than any other airline, and its A321LR carries 138 seats in JetBlue's configuration, 24 of them Mint, while a widebody crossing the Atlantic needs enough demand to fill 250 or more seats.

La Compagnie operates an Airbus A321neo with 76 lie-flat business class seats and no other cabin, flying between Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) and Paris Orly (ORY), with the seats arranged 2-2; the aircraft replaced Boeing 757s in 2019, and the airline also serves Milan from Newark and adds Nice seasonally.

TAP Air Portugal deploys its Airbus A321LRs primarily on routes between Lisbon Humberto Delgado Airport (LIS) and North America, with the Thompson Vantage lie-flat seat in a staggered configuration, and also operates the type to destinations in Africa and Brazil.

Scandinavian Airlines operates three Airbus A321LRs, fitting the Thompson Vantage in business class, on routes between Scandinavia and North America; the airline entered Chapter 11 in 2024, moved from Star Alliance to SkyTeam in September 2024, and now has Air France-KLM as a shareholder.

zh.title: 五條A321neo平躺商務艙航線：從捷藍Mint到全商務艙精品航空
zh.summary: A321neo與長程衍生型把平躺商務艙從廣體機帶進窄體機市場；捷藍航空以Mint布局紐約至洛杉磯與倫敦航線，La Compagnie以76張平躺座椅飛紐瓦克至巴黎，TAP與北歐航空則以A321LR開拓需求不足以支撐廣體機的跨大西洋航線。
body: 平躺商務艙曾是廣體機的專利，直到2014年6月15日捷藍航空在紐約甘迺迪機場（JFK）至洛杉磯機場（LAX）航線以一架A321推出Mint，當時美國、達美與聯合航空在同一航線以斜躺座椅收取高價，捷藍航空以平躺床位與明顯更優的機上產品壓低價格，競爭反應重塑了全美四家業者的跨洲高級艙市場。十年後，A321neo與長程衍生型把平躺座椅帶上美國跨洲航線與大西洋航線；A321LR可從紐約飛抵倫敦，窄體機如今直接與廣體機競爭一代以前無法進入的航線。

捷藍航空現行A321neo的Mint座艙共16席，包括14間Mint套房與2間Mint工作室，採1-1配置，每位乘客都有直通道，捷藍航空表示每張Mint座椅都是附門的私人套房，可完全放平為附Tuft & Needle適應性泡棉墊與枕頭被子的平躺床。位於前方的兩間Mint工作室配備美國航空業最大的22英寸電視、鏡面化妝台、額外儲物空間與可供第二位Mint乘客來訪的客座與桌子；The Points Guy量測工作室平躺床長逾82英寸，稱其為美國航空業最大的平躺床。跨大西洋航線使用相同座椅：A321LR配置24席Mint，包括22間套房與2間工作室，同樣採1-1配置，座椅為湯普森航空VantageSOLO。捷藍航空在2026-27年冬季每日兩班往返JFK與倫敦希斯洛機場，另有JFK至巴黎、波士頓至倫敦與巴黎航線；更廣的歐洲網絡涵蓋紐約與波士頓出發的阿姆斯特丹、都柏林與愛丁堡，以及波士頓出發的馬德里與米蘭，A321LR跨大西洋航線數量超過任何其他航空公司。

其餘三家業者的布局各不相同。La Compagnie的A321neo全機僅有76張平躺商務艙座椅，沒有其他客艙，核心航線為紐瓦克自由國際機場（EWR）至巴黎奧利機場（ORY），座椅採2-2配置，並非每位乘客都有直通道；該機型於2019年取代波音757，把斜躺座椅升級為真正的平躺床，業者另有紐瓦克至米蘭航線與季節性的尼斯航線。TAP葡萄牙航空主要以A321LR往返里斯本與北美，商務艙採用交錯配置的湯普森Vantage平躺座椅；里斯本位於歐洲主要樞紐最西端，縮短了跨大西洋航程，A321LR也飛往非洲與巴西。北歐航空僅有三架A321LR，同樣配備湯普森Vantage座椅，往返斯堪地那維亞與北美；該公司於2024年進入破產保護程序，同年9月自星空聯盟轉投天合聯盟，法航荷航如今為股東。A321LR載客量較低，讓需求不足以支撐廣體機的航線得以開通：捷藍航空配置僅138席，其中24席為Mint，廣體機跨大西洋航線則需250席以上的需求。
